title: OP kill all script
script:
game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    for _,v in game:GetService("Players"):GetChildren() do
        task.wait()
        if v.Name ~= game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Name then
            local args = {
                v.Character:WaitForChild("HeadTop"),
                vector.create(0,0,0),
                vector.create(0,0,0),
                v,
                "9x19mm Parabellum Mk 243 Mod 0 JHP",
                1000000,
                vector.create(0,0,0),
                {
                    vector.create(0,0,0),
                    v.Character:WaitForChild("HeadTop"),
                    vector.create(0,0,0),
                    vector.create(0,0,0),
                    1000000,
                    v
                },
                "I HATE NIGGERS, I HATE NIGGERS, I HATE NIGGERS, I HATE NIGGERS, I HATE NIGGERS, I HATE NIGGERS, I HATE NIGGERS, I HATE NIGGERS",
                "I HATE NIGGERS, I HATE NIGGERS, I HATE NIGGERS, I HATE NIGGERS, I HATE NIGGERS, I HATE NIGGERS, I HATE NIGGERS, I HATE NIGGERS",
                true
            }
            game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Connections"):WaitForChild("HitEvent"):FireServer(unpack(args))
        end
    end
end)
